description: Development regression set from two ACL Anthology 2025 papers. Questions and gold evidence were frozen before generation, but the set was used for offline retrieval diagnosis before the generation run.
reclassification_reason: H5 was used for offline retrieval diagnosis and generic table/routing fixes before generation; it cannot serve as an unseen confirmation set. The set is retained for regression only.
freeze_policy: Do not tune retrieval or answer formatting against this set. If a failure is found, reclassify this set as development-regression and create a fresh unseen set for confirmation.
